role: production account uniqueness and free-trial entitlement policy
product_goal: One production account/trial entitlement per verified person-user, no credit card required for the free trial, and non-destructive post-trial limited mode.

identity.production_requirement: Authentication adapter must supply a stable verified person-subject or equivalent server-side identity anchor.
identity.storage: CACE stores only a server-derived opaque person key/hash; raw identity-provider secrets or identity documents are not stored in ordinary application tables.
identity.one_account_rule: One active production account is bound to one person key. If the same person returns, recover/merge the existing account instead of issuing a new trial account.
identity.deletion_rule: Deleting an account does not automatically erase the anti-abuse trial-entitlement record; retention/deletion must follow the published privacy policy and applicable law.

trial.duration: deployment-configured; not hard-coded by public help
trial.starts: first successful production account/trial claim for the person key
trial.duplicate_person_claim: reject and route to account recovery/merge

premium_capabilities_may_be_disabled: new scientific execution above free limits

anti_abuse.device_or_network_risk_signals: optional secondary abuse signals only; never the sole person identity

safety.principle: Trial enforcement must be transparent, reversible by valid licensing, and non-destructive.
safety.user_data_rule: Users retain a reasonable path to retrieve and delete their own data after trial expiry.
safety.sandbox_rule: The hardened private CACE layer remains sandboxed regardless of trial/license state.
safety.evidence_rule: Account/trial/payment/license state never changes scientific proof or verification truth.
